import json, itertools, os
R = []
def add(p, r): R.append([p, r])

EPC = 'STUVWXYZ'
# ---- parse ----
add(r'^(\S+) w (\S+) (\S+).*$', r'\g<1> \g<2> \g<3>')
for i, f in enumerate('abcdefgh'):
    add(' %s[36]$' % f, ' ' + EPC[i])
flags = 'KQkq'
for bits in itertools.product([0, 1], repeat=4):
    s = ''.join(f for f, b in zip(flags, bits) if b) or '-'
    add(' %s ' % s, ' ' + ''.join('+' if b else '-' for b in bits) + ' ')
for d in range(8, 0, -1):
    add(str(d), '_' * d)
add('/', '//')
add(r' (....) (.)$', r'//\g<1>\g<2>')
add(r'\A', '#')

# ---- selection ----
MARK = {'P': '1', 'N': '2', 'B': '3', 'R': '4', 'Q': '5', 'K': '6'}
for b in range(80):
    if b % 10 >= 8:
        continue
    for pc, m in MARK.items():
        add(r'(?m)^#(.{%d})%s(.*)$' % (b, pc), r'\g<0>' + '\n%' + r'\g<1>' + m + r'\g<2>')
add(r'(?m)^#.*\n?', '')

DST = '[_pnbrq]'


def step(m, pc, s, k):
    a = abs(s)
    mid = '((?:.{%d}_){%d}.{%d})' % (a - 1, k - 1, a - 1)
    if s > 0:
        add(r'(?m)^%(.*)' + m + mid + '(' + DST + r')(.*)$',
            r'\g<0>' + '\n&' + r'\g<1>_\g<2>' + pc + r'\g<4>')
    else:
        add(r'(?m)^%(.*)(' + DST + ')' + mid + m + r'(.*)$',
            r'\g<0>' + '\n&' + r'\g<1>' + pc + r'\g<3>_\g<4>')


# pawns
add(r'(?m)^%(.*)_(.{9})1(.*)$', r'\g<0>' + '\n&' + r'\g<1>P\g<2>_\g<3>')
add(r'(?m)^%(.*)([pnbrq])(.{8})1(.*)$', r'\g<0>' + '\n&' + r'\g<1>P\g<3>_\g<4>')
add(r'(?m)^%(.*)([pnbrq])(.{10})1(.*)$', r'\g<0>' + '\n&' + r'\g<1>P\g<3>_\g<4>')
for f in range(8):
    E = EPC[f]
    add(r'(?m)^%%(.{%d})_(.{8})1p(.*)%s$' % (20 + f, E), r'\g<0>' + '\n&' + r'\g<1>P\g<2>__\g<3>' + E)
    add(r'(?m)^%%(.{%d})_(.{9})p1(.*)%s$' % (20 + f, E), r'\g<0>' + '\n&' + r'\g<1>P\g<2>__\g<3>' + E)
# knights
for s in (8, 12, 19, 21):
    step('2', 'N', s, 1)
    step('2', 'N', -s, 1)
# king
for s in (1, 9, 10, 11):
    step('6', 'K', s, 1)
    step('6', 'K', -s, 1)
add(r'(?m)^%(.{74})6__R(..)\+(.*)$', r'\g<0>' + '\n&' + r'\g<1>KKKR\g<2>+\g<3>')
add(r'(?m)^%(.{70})R___6(.{6})\+(.*)$', r'\g<0>' + '\n&' + r'\g<1>R_KKK\g<2>+\g<3>')
# sliders
for m, pc, dirs in (('3', 'B', (9, 11)), ('4', 'R', (1, 10)), ('5', 'Q', (1, 9, 10, 11))):
    for s in dirs:
        for k in range(1, 8):
            step(m, pc, s, k)
            step(m, pc, -s, k)
# clear ep on all generated moves
add(r'(?m)^(&.*).$', r'\g<1>-')
# double pushes (set ep)
for f in range(8):
    add(r'(?m)^%%(.{%d})_(.{9})_(.{9})1(.*).$' % (40 + f),
        r'\g<0>' + '\n&' + r'\g<1>P\g<2>_\g<3>_\g<4>' + EPC[f])
add(r'(?m)^%.*\n?', '')

# ---- legality filter ----
att = []
for s in (8, 12, 19, 21):
    att.append('K.{%d}n' % (s - 1))
    att.append('n.{%d}K' % (s - 1))
for s in (1, 9, 10, 11):
    att.append('K.{%d}k' % (s - 1))
    att.append('k.{%d}K' % (s - 1))
att.append('p.{8}K')
att.append('p.{10}K')
for s, cls in ((1, '[rq]'), (10, '[rq]'), (9, '[bq]'), (11, '[bq]')):
    att.append('K(?:.{%d}_)*.{%d}%s' % (s - 1, s - 1, cls))
    att.append('%s(?:.{%d}_)*.{%d}K' % (cls, s - 1, s - 1))
for a in att:
    add(r'(?m)^&.*' + a + r'.*\n?', '')

# ---- post-processing ----
add('KKKR', '_RK_')
add('R_KKK', '__KR_')
add(r'(?m)^(&.{0,7})P', r'\g<1>Q')
add(r'(?m)^(&.{74}[^K].{5})..', r'\g<1>--')
add(r'(?m)^(&.{77}[^R].{2}).', r'\g<1>-')
add(r'(?m)^(&.{70}[^R].{10}).', r'\g<1>-')
add(r'(?m)^(&.{7}[^r].{74}).', r'\g<1>-')
add(r'(?m)^(&[^r].{82}).', r'\g<1>-')
# format
add(r'(?m)^&(.*)//(....)(.)$', r'\g<1> b \g<2> \g<3> 0 0')
add('//', '/')
for d in range(8, 0, -1):
    add('_' * d, str(d))
for bits in itertools.product([0, 1], repeat=4):
    s = ''.join(f for f, b in zip(flags, bits) if b) or '-'
    add(' b ' + ''.join(r'\+' if b else '-' for b in bits) + ' ', ' b ' + s + ' ')
for i, f in enumerate('abcdefgh'):
    add('(?m) %s 0 0$' % EPC[i], ' %s3 0 0' % f)
add(r'\n+', '\n')
add(r'\A\n+', '')
add(r'\n+\Z', '')
out = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..', 're.json')
json.dump(R, open(out, 'w'))
print(len(R), os.path.getsize(out))
